how_to_apply: Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in.
Open the Student Registration facility.
Complete the enrolment process using the information requested on the portal.
Enter accurate personal, contact and educational qualification details.
Provide graduation passing information and other required certificates.
Complete all mandatory profile sections until the NATS profile shows 100% completion.
Save the generated NATS Enrolment ID.
Visit Indian Bank Careers or the NATS portal.
Locate the recruitment titled Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank - 2026.
Read the detailed advertisement and verify the qualification, graduation passing date, age and experience restrictions.
Open the corresponding online application facility.
Click New Registration if registering for the recruitment for the first time.
Enter your name, contact details and email address.
Note the provisional registration number and password.
Use the Save and Next facility while completing the application.
Enter the required personal, address, graduation and category details.
Select one eligible State/UT.
Choose the preferred districts within that State/UT.
Select one of the prescribed local languages for the language proficiency requirement.
Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
Complete the additional details requested by the application form.
Open the Preview tab and carefully verify all entered information.
Select Complete Registration after confirming the details.
Pay the applicable fee through the online payment facility.
Complete the application by 25 November 2026.
Save the application printout and payment confirmation for future reference.

Important: Once the application is finally submitted, changes to the submitted details will not be permitted. Candidates should ensure that their name, date of birth and educational details match their official certificates.
important_instructions: Indian Bank has announced 1,500 apprenticeship training seats for FY 2026-27. Online applications are open from 5 November to 25 November 2026. Graduation in any discipline is required. Graduation must have been completed between 1 April 2022 and 1 November 2026. The age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 1 November 2026, with applicable relaxation. Candidates with one year or more of post-qualification work experience are not eligible. Applicants who have already undergone apprenticeship training are ineligible. Only one State/UT can be selected. Candidates must maintain a fully completed NATS 2.0 profile. The application fee is Rs. 800 or Rs. 175 plus GST, depending on category. Selection includes a 100-mark online test and Local Language Proficiency Test. The bank may conduct an interview at its discretion. Local language exemption is available with the prescribed school-study evidence. The stipend depends on whether the allotted branch is Metro/Urban or Rural/Semi-Urban. Training lasts for 12 months. Apprenticeship does not guarantee regular or contractual employment. Ex-Servicemen and Disabled Ex-Servicemen are not eligible under the notification. Candidates must satisfy document verification and medical fitness requirements. The bank may revise the training seats, selection requirements or schedule through official updates.

content_sections.text: Indian Bank has issued the for the engagement of 1,500 apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for FY 2026-27. The notification contains the complete State/UT-wise and district-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, reservation conditions, stipend, fees, online examination pattern, local language requirements, application instructions and document-upload specifications. Official Notification PDF: Download Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 1500 Training Seats
content_sections.text: Indian Bank has announced 1,500 apprenticeship seats across 30 States and Union Territories . Uttar Pradesh has the highest number of seats with 285, followed by Tamil Nadu with 270 and West Bengal with 145. District-Wise Vacancies: Annexure III of the official notification provides the district-wise distribution of apprenticeship training locations. Candidates should check this annexure before choosing their preferred districts. Reservation Clarification: PwBD reservation is horizontal and is included within the advertised 1,500 training seats. These vacancies must not be added separately to the total. The advertised seats are tentative and may change according to the bank's actual apprenticeship requirements.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government. Graduation must have been completed within the period specified by the bank. Important Graduation Year Restriction: Candidates who completed graduation before 1 April 2022 are not eligible. Candidates whose graduation results were declared after 1 November 2026 are also not eligible. No. Candidates who passed graduation before 1 April 2022 do not satisfy the passing-date requirement under the FY 2026-27 apprenticeship notification. Only candidates whose final graduation result was declared on or before 1 November 2026 meet the notified qualification cut-off. Candidates awaiting their final result after that date are not eligible. The bank does not permit applications from candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training, are currently undergoing apprenticeship training or had their apprenticeship terminated due to their own fault. Candidates who have accumulated one year or more of work experience after completing their educational qualification are also ineligible.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 20 to 28 years as on 1 November 2026 , with applicable relaxation for eligible categories. Both dates in the prescribed General/EWS date-of-birth range are inclusive.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 in Metro/Urban branches or Rs. 12,300 in Rural/Semi-Urban branches during the 12-month training period. Stipend Clarification: The stipend is not a regular bank employee salary. Apprentices are not eligible for additional allowances or regular employee benefits under this engagement.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship duration is 12 months of on-the-job training under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Apprentices are entitled to bank holidays and one casual leave after completing each month of training. A maximum of four casual leaves may be taken at one time. The notification requires more than 338 paid days during the 12-month period to become eligible for the Certificate of Proficiency, subject to the prescribed assessment and completion conditions. After successful training and assessment, the Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will issue a digital Certificate of Proficiency through NATS 2.0. No. Apprenticeship is a fixed-duration training arrangement. Indian Bank has no obligation to provide regular or contractual employment after completion of training, and apprentices do not have a right to claim employment with the bank.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 800 plus GST for General, OBC and EWS candidates . SC, ST and PwBD candidates must pay Rs. 175 plus GST. Fee Payment Period: 5 November to 25 November 2026. Payment Mode: Online through Debit Card, Credit Card or Internet Banking using the available payment gateway. The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable bank transaction charges are additional.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection procedure includes an online objective examination and a Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) . Indian Bank may also conduct an interview at its discretion. NATS Registration: Eligible candidates complete their apprenticeship registration and profile. Online Application: Candidates submit the application and pay the applicable fee. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the 100-mark objective examination. Local Language Proficiency Test: Qualified candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the selected State/UT language unless exempt. Interview, If Conducted: The bank may include or dispense with an interview. Merit List: Candidates are ranked according to the applicable State/UT and category-wise merit rules. Document Verification: Eligibility and supporting certificates are verified. Medical Fitness: Engagement is subject to the bank's prescribed medical fitness requirements. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates receive their digital engagement through NATS 2.0.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The online examination consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks , with a composite duration of 60 minutes. Indian Bank will determine the minimum qualifying marks on the aggregate examination score. There are no separate minimum qualifying marks for individual sections. SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates receive a 5% relaxation in the prescribed aggregate qualifying percentage. The bank will prepare merit lists State/UT-wise and category-wise according to online examination performance. Candidates will be ranked in descending order of aggregate marks. If candidates have identical marks at the cut-off, the older candidate will receive preference. Where examinations are conducted in multiple sessions, scores will be normalized using the equi-percentile method. A State/UT-wise and category-wise waiting list may also be prepared to fill unoccupied apprenticeship seats.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Local Language Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be able to read, write, speak and understand one of the specified local languages of their selected State or Union Territory. The Local Language Proficiency Test will be conducted after the online examination. Candidates who fail to qualify will not be engaged as apprentices. Candidates who provide Class 8, Class 10 or Class 12 marksheets or certificates proving they studied their selected local language are exempt from appearing in the Local Language Proficiency Test. Important: Candidates without the prescribed language-study evidence must qualify in the LLPT. The test will be held at a centre decided by the bank in the relevant State/UT, and candidates must bear their own travel expenses.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice State and District Preference 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants can apply for only one State or Union Territory . During registration, candidates may choose three preferred districts within the selected State/UT. The bank gives the applicant's resident district the first preference in the applicable merit arrangement, while candidates may select two additional neighbouring districts. Important: District preferences do not guarantee posting in a particular branch or district. Indian Bank may allot candidates to any district within their selected State/UT according to availability and operational requirements.

Merely registering on NATS without completing the recruitment-specific application is not sufficient.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in . Open the Student Registration facility. Complete the enrolment process using the information requested on the portal. Enter accurate personal, contact and educational qualification details. Provide graduation passing information and other required certificates. Complete all mandatory profile sections until the NATS profile shows 100% completion. Save the generated NATS Enrolment ID. Important: Once the application is finally submitted, changes to the submitted details will not be permitted. Candidates should ensure that their name, date of birth and educational details match their official certificates.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents and records available for registration, application and subsequent verification, as applicable. Graduation degree certificate and marksheets. Proof showing the graduation result was declared on or before 1 November 2026. Date-of-birth proof. Valid identity proof. NATS 2.0 Enrolment ID. Recent passport-size colour photograph. Scanned signature. Left thumb impression. Handwritten declaration. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS category certificate, if applicable. PwBD disability certificate or UDID card, where applicable. Class 8, 10 or 12 certificate showing study of the selected local language, if claiming LLPT exemption. Other applicable documents requested by the bank during verification. Documents must be uploaded in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format. Candidates must also capture a live photograph through a webcam or mobile phone using the application portal's facility. The handwritten declaration must be written in English on white paper using black ink. It must be written in the candidate's own handwriting and must not be written entirely in capital letters. The official declaration is: Candidates should reproduce the declaration exactly as prescribed in Annexure II of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Centres 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can indicate their preferred examination centre while applying, subject to the options provided by the application form. However, Indian Bank may allot a different centre according to availability. Requests for examination centre changes will not be entertained. Candidates must bear their own examination-related travel expenses.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: Indian Bank will issue examination call letters through its official website or other recruitment-related portals identified in the notification. Candidates must download their call letters using the registration number or roll number and the required login credentials. Call letters will not be sent by post. Applicants should regularly check their registered email and the official bank recruitment website for examination updates.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Certificate and Contract Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a digital apprenticeship engagement offer through NATS 2.0. The apprenticeship contract is normally for 12 months and terminates automatically after completion of the prescribed training period. Candidates must report at the allotted bank branch or training venue on the specified joining date. Failure to report may lead to termination of the apprenticeship contract. A candidate who voluntarily leaves the training before completing the contract may be required to pay an amount equivalent to one month's stipend, under the notified conditions. Separate provisions apply to termination after securing gainful employment or due to medical grounds. Candidates should read the full contractual conditions before accepting the apprenticeship.

faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice seats are in the Indian Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Indian Bank has notified 1500 tentative apprentice training seats across 30 States/UTs, with the highest numbers in Uttar Pradesh (285) and Tamil Nadu (270).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Indian Bank apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026. Online registration and fee payment are open from 5 November 2026 to 25 November 2026, both days inclusive.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Indian Bank apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: A graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized University, passed on or after 01.04.2022 and not later than 01.11.2026, with the result declared on or before 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Indian Bank apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: Minimum 20 years and maximum 28 years as on 01.11.2026. SC/ST get 5 years' relaxation, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years and PwBD 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What stipend do Indian Bank apprentices get?
faq.answer: The total stipend is ₹15,000/- per month at metro/urban branches and ₹12,300/- per month at rural/semi-urban branches. Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Indian Bank apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is ₹800/- plus GST for General/OBC/EWS candidates and ₹175/- plus GST for SC/ST/PwBD candidates, paid online only.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Indian Bank apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: Register with a 100% complete profile on the NATS 2.0 Portal (www.nats.education.gov.in), then apply through the Indian Bank careers page or the NATS portal link "Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank – 2026" and pay the fee online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Indian Bank apprentices?
faq.answer: Selection is through a 100-mark online objective test of 60 minutes and a Local Language Proficiency Test. The Bank may conduct an interview or dispense with it at its discretion.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one State/UT?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for only one State/UT and submit only one application; with multiple applications only the latest valid one is kept and other fees are forfeited.

faq.question: Q10. Who is not eligible for the Indian Bank apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already done or are doing apprenticeship, who have 01 year or more of job experience after their qualification, and Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-servicemen are not eligible.
